caption: The drawing depicts three figures standing in a row, occupying most of the vertical composition. The central figure, dressed in a long black robe with a red collar and white trim, stands with both arms raised. This figure has short dark hair, a crown or radiating lines around the head, and appears to emit a faint, upward-curving line, possibly smoke or a spiritual aura. On either side of the central figure are two standing figures, each with a halo around their head. The left figure wears a long red robe with a white shawl draped over one shoulder and cradles an object in one hand. The right figure, also haloed, wears a long robe with red and black/gray coloring, holding a bent stick or branch with leaves. In the background, red and gold stylized churches or buildings with domes or spires are visible. Above the figures is a backdrop with red drapery and a central dark oval or bell-shaped form hanging from above. The entire scene is framed with a thick, dark border, and the drawing is rendered with visible brush strokes, giving it a textured appearance. The predominant colors are earthy browns, reds, blacks, and creams, with some white highlights, creating a muted but warm palette.
title: Retablo - The Holy Family
